events.title: Desert Echo – Next Fest Live
events.summary: Desert Echo is streaming throughout Steam Next Fest!Join us to see the robot in action: holding the line against endless desert hordes, building defenses and surviving wave after wave.▶ Play the free demo: it’s available right now on this page. ★ Add Desert Echo to your wishlist to get notified when it launches. 💬 Drop your questions in the chat. The developer will reply whenever he’s live.Desert Echo is developed solo by DevTraum. Every wishlist and every bit of feedback helps a lot!

events.title: Visual & Performance Update: New Foliage, Terrain and Smoother Portals
events.summary: Hey survivors! This update makes the desert look better and run smoother when the waves get big. Maps & Environment Tutorial Map: new foliage, stones and reworked landscape Demo Map: new foliage and reworked landscape New textures for mountains, rocks and stone foliage New grass, plus small stones scattered along the cliffs for a more natural look Performance Portal optimisation: enemy portals are now much lighter on performance Enemy optimisation: enemy textures were optimised, so large hordes

events.title: Tower Abilities Update: Energy Shields, Elemental Shells & Fixes
events.summary: Hey survivors! This update gives your turrets new abilities, cleans up the tower interface and fixes several issues you reported. New Tower Abilities You can buy these directly in the tower interface: Energy Shield: an extra layer that absorbs damage before the turret's health takes any hits Shield Regeneration: shields recharge over time.
